text:
You are all the more my eyes because you see

what in my eyes I bear of your life.

And so I walk blind to myself,

lit by my eyes that burn

with your fire.


You are more than my hearing because you hear

what in my hearing I bear of your voice.

And so I walk deaf to myself,

filled with the tendernesses of your accent.

Your voice alone!


You are more than my sense of smell because you smell

what my sense of smell bears of your scent.

And so I go unaware of my own aroma,

exhaling the perfumes of your domains,

soon a garden of you.


You are more than my tongue because you taste

what my tongue bears of you alone,

and so I go insensible to my own flavors,

tasting the delight of yours,

flavor of you alone.


You are more than my sense of touch because in me

you caress your caress and overflow.

And so I touch in my body the delight

of your hands, burned by mine.


I am only the living mirror

of your senses. Fidelity

in the throat of the volcano.

translation.title: You Are All the More My Eyes Because You See
translation.editorial_note: The translation maintains the anaphora of the five senses and the closing volcanic image.
